notes: No resistor: the sketch uses INPUT_PULLUP, so pin 2 is pulled high internally and the button pulls it to ground.
Button straddles the centre gap in columns 4 and 6. Rows f-j are bank 'b' and rows a-e are bank 't', following the image row labels.
Pin 2 goes by blue wire to column 6 (row i, bank b). GND goes by black wire to column 4 (row c, bank t).
Which button legs form side 1 and side 2 is assumed: column 4 is side 1 and column 6 is side 2, so pressing the button joins pin 2 to GND.
The GND wire goes to the Leonardo's first GND header pin, taken as GND.1.
